request_user:
Fact: integration_means
What to find: Technical means for integrating the model (usage instructions, APIs, serving frameworks, prompt/chat format).
Card sections that often contain it: How to Use, Quickstart, Usage, Deployment

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Load with Hugging Face transformers (v4.53.0+) via AutoModelForCausalLM/AutoTokenizer and the chat template (apply_chat_template); /think and /no_think system-prompt flags or enable_thinking kwarg toggle extended thinking; tool calling via xml_tools or python_tools; deploy with vLLM or SGLang in an OpenAI-compatible API (chat_template_kwargs supported); local inference with llama.cpp, ONNX, MLX, MLC and ExecuTorch; YaRN rope_scaling config for longer context.
quotes: The modeling code for SmolLM3 is available in transformers `v4.53.0`, so make sure to upgrade your transformers version.
you can provide the `/think` and `/no_think` flags through the system prompt
We also provide the option of specifying the whether to use extended thinking through the `enable_thinking` kwarg
Under the argument `xml_tools` for standard tool-calling
Or under `python_tools`: then the model will call tools like python functions in a `<code>` snippet
You can use vLLM and SGLang to deploy the model in an API compatible with OpenAI format.
For local inference, you can use `llama.cpp`, `ONNX`, `MLX`, `MLC` and `ExecuTorch`.
